title: Broadcast status is derived in frontend from HogFlow.status + latest batch job
answers: How is a broadcast's status represented?
Is there a broadcast model in the backend?
body:
- Broadcasts are HogFlows with `origin_product="broadcasts"` (`HogFlow.OriginProduct.BROADCASTS`); no broadcast model or status column.
- Persisted: `HogFlow.State` = draft/active/archived (`backend/models/hog_flow/hog_flow.py:HogFlow`) plus latest `HogFlowBatchJob.State` = waiting/queued/active/completed/cancelled/failed (`backend/models/hog_flow_batch_job/hog_flow_batch_job.py`).
- UI: `BroadcastStatus = draft|scheduled|sending|sent|failed|archived` in `frontend/Broadcasts/broadcastsLogic.ts:getBroadcastStatus`.
- Rules: draft/archived from flow; else job waiting/queued/active→sending; completed→sent; failed/cancelled→failed; no job→scheduled.
- Pinned by `frontend/Broadcasts/broadcastStatus.test.ts`; labels/colours in `BroadcastsTable.tsx:STATUS_CONFIG` (table also checks `item.status === 'draft'` directly).
- `BroadcastScene.tsx`: NotFound unless origin_product is broadcasts; draft→`BroadcastWizard`, else read-only summary.
- Schedules: `backend/models/hog_flow_schedule/hog_flow_schedule.py:HogFlowSchedule` (active/paused/completed).
says: Broadcast progress status doesn't update when underlying job batch completes
Broadcast shows sending when job still waiting in queue
Broadcast archive state persists even after workflow execution finishes
search: Broadcast status in the UI is derived from HogFlow.State (draft/active/archived) plus the latest HogFlowBatchJob.State (waiting/queued/active/completed/cancelled/failed), with no dedicated broadcast model or status column. The BroadcastStatus enum (draft|scheduled|sending|sent|failed|archived) maps flow states (draft/archived) directly, while job states determine the rest: waiting/queued/active→sending, completed→sent, failed/cancelled→failed, and no job→scheduled. Broadcasts are HogFlows filtered by origin_product='broadcasts' (HogFlow.OriginProduct.BROADCASTS). Test cases in broadcastStatus.test.ts pin the mapping; BroadcastsTable.tsx:STATUS_CONFIG defines labels and colors and checks item.status==='draft' directly. BroadcastScene.tsx returns NotFound unless origin_product is broadcasts; draft status routes to BroadcastWizard, other statuses show read-only summary. Applies to broadcast UI display, status derivation, and scene navigation in frontend/Broadcasts/.
